title: Maximum path sum
statementMd:
A path is any connected downward-or-turning sequence of nodes (it need not pass through the root and has at least one node). Return the maximum path sum (values may be negative). The tree is given as a level-order list where `None` marks a missing child (like `[3, 9, 20, None, None, 15, 7]`); the helper `build_tree` in the solution shows how it is read, and in your function the argument is already that list.

**Example:** `max_path_sum([1, 2, 3])` returns `6`.
hints: Return the best downward gain from each node while updating a global best.
